items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I got along with all of them. Ben Webster... The band -- ... Yeah. That was a great band.

ctx.x: Let's get back a little bit to Duke unless you got something else you want to say. I would like to talk about some of the guys in the band, you know all the guys, how did you get along with them, guys like Sonny was probably there the longest.

I got along with all of them. Ben Webster, he used to say, don't wake up Tom. Ben would have his beer and have a bottle and he'd sit there and drink all the time and he would get high but you wouldn't know it, see, he would get them sleepy eyes and go to sleep. The band --
How did you like his playing Ben Webster
